rules: Mission Specification must exist in base_sha before dispatch and remains immutable for the attempt.
Work Order and Acceptance Contract must be introduced by the same dedicated control-only dispatch commit.
Work Order, Requirements Manifest and Acceptance Contract must be introduced by the same dedicated control-only dispatch commit.
Work Order and Acceptance Contract are immutable after dispatch.
Machine semantic risk policy may raise but never lower the risk floor.
implementation_paths define the reviewed product surface and all product-mutating commits must use implementer_git_email.
MEDIUM+ requires signed external review and verifier-owned adversarial predicate coverage.
Work Order may reference but never create its own merge whitelist or trust root.
attempt_id is immutable; failed attempts are superseded, not rewritten.
Every machine-extracted normative clause from the base-owned Mission Specification must map to a Requirement ID and acceptance predicate.
